Definition: from the base of G2360; wailing:--lamentation.
BiblicalUsage: thrēnos is the word for lamentation, wailing. In Matthew 2:18, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning. The King James Version reads the word here, while the Greek text behind the modern editions reads differently: SBL reads κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὀδυρμὸς πολύς, no θρῆνος token.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe lament is honest prayer, and God does not turn away from those who weep before Him.
